title: Comment "Watermark" and I'll send you the full setup guide 👇 Claude just started leaving watermarks
description: Comment "Watermark" and I'll send you the full setup guide 👇 Claude just started leaving watermarks on everything it creates. Here's how to get rid of them in 30 seconds. Anthropic just announced they're watermarking all the text Claude writes. This watermark is completely invisible and even survives when you paste it outside Claude and re-edit the text. Here's how to remove it: 1. Search for the Claude skill "Watermarks Remover", built by Guillaume Meyer (github.com/guillaumemeyer/watermarks-remover, free and MIT licensed, and all the credit here goes to him because he built the entire thing) 2. Go inside the skills folder → skill.md → Download Raw File 3. Go to Claude → Customize → Skills → dropdown → Upload Skill 4. Drag and drop the file in Now just type "/remove-ai-marks" and paste in your text. The output comes back completely watermark free so you can copy and paste it and avoid detectors. Follow mavgpt for more AI videos. #ai #claude #claudeskills #aitools #watermark
